note: Keeps the span from the first even element to the last even element.

name: שני מעברי בחירה
src: l=>{ const r=[...l]; for(let p=0;p<2&&p<r.length;p++){ let m=p; for(let i=p+1;i<r.length;i++) if(r[i]<r[m]) m=i; const t=r[p]; r[p]=r[m]; r[m]=t; } return r; }
note: Runs two passes of selection sort.

name: ריצה עולה ארוכה
src: l=>{ let bs=0, bl=0, s=0; for(let i=0;i<=l.length;i++){ if(i===l.length||(i>0&&l[i]<=l[i-1])){ if(i-s>bl){ bl=i-s; bs=s; } s=i; } } return l.slice(bs,bs+bl); }
note: Returns the first longest strictly increasing contiguous run.

src: l=>{ const s=[]; for(const x of l){ while(s.length&&s[s.length-1]<x) s.pop(); s.push(x); } return s; }
note: Keeps what remains on a stack where each new element pops smaller ones.

src: l=>{ const r=[]; let i=0; while(i<l.length){ r.push(l[i]); i+=l[i]%3+1; } return r; }
note: Collects elements visited by hopping forward by each value modulo 3 plus one.

src: l=>{ if(l.length<2) return [...l]; let b=0; for(let i=1;i+1<l.length;i++) if(l[i]+l[i+1]>l[b]+l[b+1]) b=i; return [...l.slice(0,b),...l.slice(b+2)]; }
note: Removes the adjacent pair with the largest sum.

name: מעגלי תמורה
src: l=>{ const s=[...l].sort((a,b)=>a-b), p=l.map(x=>s.indexOf(x)), seen=[]; let c=0; for(let i=0;i<p.length;i++) if(!seen[i]){ c++; let j=i; while(!seen[j]){ seen[j]=1; j=p[j]; } } return c; }
note: Counts cycles of the permutation that maps each position to its sorted rank.

name: שלשות של 30
src: l=>{ let c=0; for(let i=0;i<l.length;i++) for(let j=i+1;j<l.length;j++) for(let k=j+1;k<l.length;k++) if(l[i]+l[j]+l[k]===30) c++; return Math.min(15,c); }
note: Counts triples of elements summing to 30, capped at 15.
